method.contrast: Computed CSS foreground and composited ancestor backgrounds, WCAG relative luminance. SVG score badges compared with the circle fill. Inactive controls excluded. No claim of a full WCAG audit.
method.font: Declared CSS size multiplied by graph viewport transform, or SVG screen matrix. Panel sizes are unscaled.
method.menu: Bounding rectangles after contextmenu MouseEvents at (viewport width - 5, viewport height - 5).
method.placeholder: Canvas text width versus usable input width; textarea wrapping is allowed.
method.clippingScope: Panel text only; maps are separately inspected in screenshots.
method.environment: Headless Google Chrome, Vite local server. 320/390 x 844, 1024/1440 x 768 CSS px. Screenshots are full-page, not viewport-height crops.
